translations: which He has sent down to you and whoever
from him his evil deeds and make great
puzzle.hint: A divine promise for those with taqwa (God-consciousness): Allah will always provide a way out of their difficulties.
puzzle.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْرًا
puzzle.verseEn: That is the command of Allāh, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allāh - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.
